project_dates_ck.name: project_dates_ck
project_dates_ck.value: "project"."end_date" IS NULL OR "project"."start_date" IS NULL OR "project"."end_date" >= "project"."start_date"

equipment_item_case_needs_project_ck.name: equipment_item_case_needs_project_ck
equipment_item_case_needs_project_ck.value: "equipment_item"."case_id" IS NULL OR "equipment_item"."project_id" IS NOT NULL

equipment_item_status_location_ck.name: equipment_item_status_location_ck
equipment_item_status_location_ck.value:
("equipment_item"."status" IN ('available', 'returned') AND "equipment_item"."project_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("equipment_item"."status" IN ('on_project', 'in_use', 'ready_for_return', 'missing') AND "equipment_item"."project_id" IS NOT NULL)

project_assignment_end_ck.name: project_assignment_end_ck
project_assignment_end_ck.value: ("project_assignment"."ended_at" IS NULL) = ("project_assignment"."end_reason" IS NULL) AND ("project_assignment"."ended_at" IS NULL OR "project_assignment"."ended_at" >= "project_assignment"."assigned_at")

document_confirmed_ck.name: document_confirmed_ck
document_confirmed_ck.value: "document"."status" <> 'confirmed' OR ("document"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "document"."project_id" IS NOT NULL)

document_line_confidence_ck.name: document_line_confidence_ck
document_line_confidence_ck.value: ("document_line"."ai_confidence" IS NULL OR "document_line"."ai_confidence" BETWEEN 0 AND 1) AND ("document_line"."match_confidence" IS NULL OR "document_line"."match_confidence" BETWEEN 0 AND 1)
